title: Gandhinagar MSW Processing & Recycling Deficit
description: In Gandhinagar, daily Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) generation rose from 55 MT (2015-16) to 95 MT (2017-18), with 65 MT collected. However, average MSW processed or recycled was only 15 MT/day in 2017-18 (up from 0 MT in 2015-16 and 8 MT in 2016-17), leaving an 80 MT daily unprocessed waste deficit.

title: Bangalore Traffic Light & Intersection Automation
description: Bangalore city has 353 traffic lights managing 353 major intersections (2021 baseline data). The signals operated on static timers with 0% real-time adaptive synchronization, leading to extreme peak-hour gridlocks across major corridors.

title: Gandhinagar MSW Uncollected Waste Gap
description: Out of 95 MT total MSW generated daily in Gandhinagar (2017-18 data), the ULB collected 65 MT (up from 45 MT in 2015-16). A gap of 30 MT daily MSW remains uncollected, causing localized dumping and open burn hazards.

title: Bangalore Peak Intersection Wait Time
description: With 353 key traffic light intersections across Bangalore city, peak-hour transit wait times averaged 14.5 minutes per major intersection due to uncoordinated signal timing and high vehicle density.

title: Bangalore Traffic Signal Outage Monitoring
description: Across Bangalore's 353 traffic light intersections, signal bulb and power fault resolution currently takes an average of 48 hours to detect and repair manually, causing traffic chaos during dark signal periods.
